added.summary: Opt-in hit feedback: the screen's edges flash for each new hit id (flash), pulse while the game says the player is critical (critical), and an arc points to each recent hit (hits, as DamageDirection). Its look and timing are the theme's: Hit.vignette (.critical), Hit.ring, Hit.arc (.shield, .critical), duration-hit, duration-arc and the inset-shadow-vignette token.
A hit takes kind: crit (larger, in gold), heal, shield, weak or miss, each a Damage.number slot a theme dresses; color still overrides it.

Pack slots for the combat HUD: Damage.number (.crit, .heal, .shield, .weak, .miss), Hit.ring, Hit.arc, Hit.vignette, Combo.plate, .count and .multiplier, Feed.row (.self), Feed.name, Feed.plate, Celebrate.title and .halo, Boss.phase and Ring.rest.

fixed.summary: A nine-slice shape named only in a pack slot's dressing (nine-ring in Ring.fill) draws: the cook bundles the images the default pack's own slots name, not only those the code writes.
A defeated boss shows no lost-health ghost, and its phase marks are dark with a light rim, so they read on any fill.
The share still to fill is a ring of its own (Ring.rest), so it parts from the ring's middle.
The level-up title sits on a dark band and reads at AA over its burst.
Its plate, count and multiplier are the theme's Combo slots; the multiplier is in gold and the count rolls to a new value.
Its rows and names are the theme's Feed slots, as are PickupFeed's plate and DamageDirection's ring and arcs.
